history.summary: A 2014, high-finish 34-storey landmark beside AMK Hub with the upcoming CR11 Cross Island Line interchange essentially at the doorstep (100m). The listed $1,497 psf sits far below the $2,040 district median, but that gap is misleading — Centro is a SOHO/loft-stack development, so the headline median is skewed by smaller premium units; still, an integrated-transit 3BR at this price with CRL incoming is a strong setup.
history.rating_rationale: The standout catalyst is CR11 Ang Mo Kio becoming a Cross Island Line interchange (~2030) at 100m — within-500m future MRT is the strongest single uplift in the rubric, and 100m is doorstep. Pair that with AMK Hub integration, a well-finished 2014 building (DP Architects, one of AMK's tallest, premium finishes) and a 6.2%/yr resale CAGR over 77 txns. The $1,497-vs-$2,040 psf gap overstates cheapness (loft/SOHO unit mix skews the district median), so I treat value as fair-to-slightly-positive rather than a deep discount. Limited common-area space and a more couple/expat-than-family layout temper broad upgrader appeal, holding it to Buy.
red_flags: Headline PSF discount is inflated by Centro's SOHO/loft unit mix — not a clean ~27% bargain
Reviews note limited common-area/facility space; layout suits couples/expats more than large families
Smaller development footprint and 77-txn base = thinner liquidity than 500+ unit peers
catalysts: CR11 Ang Mo Kio Cross Island Line interchange (~2030) at 100m — doorstep future-MRT uplift
Direct integration with AMK Hub and existing NSL Ang Mo Kio MRT — rare integrated-transit convenience
2014 premium-finish landmark tower with city/landed views; durable rental demand from transit access

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Excellent transit-driven rental demand — integrated with AMK Hub and the MRT, ideal for working professionals and expats; the loft/SOHO profile rents well to couples. Among the more rentable units in the batch.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 6.2%/yr resale CAGR over 77 txns is solid; the CRL interchange at 100m is a concrete, high-impact catalyst that should drive above-baseline appreciation into 2030. Value is fair once the unit-mix-skewed median is corrected.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: URA resale 6.2%/yr, sustained by CR11 interchange catalyst at 100m
